label: Работа
description: Twelve-mission case drill for работа (work, job) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form работа is the subject of нравится. First-declension feminine nouns in -а keep this bare ending in the nominative singular, naming what performs or causes the action.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. After the preposition с marking motion from, работа becomes работы. Hard feminines take the genitive singular ending -ы.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. After the preposition к expressing direction toward, работа appears as работе. The dative singular ending for first-declension feminines is -е.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of закончил takes the accusative работу, where nominative -а becomes -у. Being inanimate, работа uses this dedicated -у form.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The short adjective доволен governs the instrumental, so работа becomes работой. The instrumental singular ending for hard feminines is -ой.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. After о meaning about, работа takes the prepositional работе. The prepositional singular ending -е matches the dative for first-declension feminines.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is работы, where singular -а changes to the plural ending -ы. This -ы marks the nominative plural of hard feminine nouns.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. Hard feminines drop the vowel in the genitive plural, leaving the zero-ending form работ. The negation нет plus genitive triggers it here.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The dative plural ending -ам attaches to the stem to give работам, the things receiving the grades. The -ам ending is uniform for hard feminine plurals.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Because работа is inanimate, the accusative plural copies the nominative plural работы rather than the genitive. The direct object of оценивает stays работы.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental plural ending -ами produces работами, here the means covering the walls. This -ами ending is regular across hard feminine nouns.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After в indicating location, the prepositional plural ending -ах gives работах. This ending is constant for hard feminines in the prepositional plural.
